nodes.name: Charlie Kirk
nodes.description: Subject of the notice of claim and central figure of the series.

nodes.name: Notice of Claim Timing Anomaly
nodes.description: Persistent target: the wrongful-death notice of claim was filed approximately one year after the incident and two days before the expected release of UVU's independent review of security failures. Investigating whether the filing is preemptive.

nodes.name: Tyler Robinson 2022 Bodycam Footage Provenance Question
nodes.description: Persistent target: investigating who retained the May 31, 2022 bodycam footage for approximately three years, why it was retained past Utah's 60–90 day routine-footage retention period, and how Scripps News obtained and released it within seven days of Tyler Robinson's identification as suspect.

nodes.name: Notice of Claim Text Message Omission
nodes.description: Persistent target: the notice of claim's quotation of the Dan Flood / Chief Long text exchange omits the line "I was told students have access above us," which materially changes the contextual reading from a general "rooftops" concern to a targeted walkway-above-Charlie concern.

nodes.name: UVU Officer Allocation Ratio for Charlie Kirk Event
nodes.description: Persistent target: the notice of claim alleges UVU assigned six of 24 total officers to the outdoor event with approximately 3,000 attendees; host calculates this is mathematically an oversupply relative to UVU's 50,000-student base.

nodes.name: Utah Bodycam Routine Footage Retention Law
nodes.description: Persistent target: investigating whether the May 31, 2022 Tyler Robinson footage should have been purged under Utah's 60–90 day retention schedule for routine, non-criminal interactions.

nodes.name: UVU EMS Presence at Scene Verification
nodes.description: Persistent target: the notice of claim alleges no first responders were available; host asserts UVU's state-certified emergency medical services were on scene at the vehicle with medical bags.

nodes.name: Independent Review of UVU Security Failures
nodes.description: Persistent target: UVU-commissioned third-party review announced September 22, 2025; findings expected imminently (host reports "Friday").

claims.label: Notice of Claim Filed Against Utah, UVU PD, Chief Long, Tuminez, and Unknown Others
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk's family has filed a notice of claim against the State of Utah, the UVU Police Department, UVU Police Chief Jeffrey Long, former UVU president Astrid Tuminez, and others presently "unknown" involved in Charlie Kirk's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed notice of claim from the Utah Attorney General's office and confirm the precise list of named respondents.

claims.label: Article the Host Reads Says UVU Launched Independent External Review September 22, 2025
claims.claim: Per an Associated Press article the host shows, published September 22, 2025, Utah Valley University announced on Monday an independent external review of the fatal shooting of Charlie Kirk on its campus; the host remarks 'just 12 days after Charlie is hit.'
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference UVU board minutes and the AP wire story against UVU press releases from September 22, 2025.

claims.label: Tuminez Quoted on Review Purpose
claims.claim: Per the Associated Press article the host shows, Astrid Tuminez stated UVU "will integrate the findings into our efforts to strengthen and improve safety practices for UVU and all of Utah higher education."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Tuminez's original emailed statement to confirm exact wording.

claims.label: Clip Has Shawn Ryan Reading Harpole's Security Team Credentials
claims.claim: In a clip from the Shawn Ryan show that the host plays, Shawn Ryan reads statements from Brian Harpole's team describing the security team as including a combat-proven Marine, SEALs, 22 years on SWAT, a 30-year cop and SWAT commander and world-renowned jiu-jitsu practitioners; the host says Harpole submitted these credentials to Ryan.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve full unedited Shawn Ryan episode and verify Harpole's on-air list against TPUSA security contractor records.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie's Security Team Comprised 12 Members
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk had a total of 12 security members at the UVU event.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against TPUSA's security manifest and the eventual independent review findings.

claims.label: Text Message Identified Sorenson Staircase Roof Access
claims.claim: Per the text message the host shows, Dan Flood told Chief Jeffrey Long that a student group said there is student roof access pretty close to where CK will be set up and that the Sorenson Student Center has a couple of staircases that go up to the walkways on the roof.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original text thread metadata (timestamps, sender numbers) and confirm the recipient list.

claims.label: Chief Long Responded "I got you covered"
claims.claim: Per the text message the host shows, Chief Jeffrey Long responded to Dan Flood's rooftop-access request with the message "I got you covered."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against UVU PD records and text-message metadata.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Omits "I was told students have access above us" Line
claims.claim: The host says the notice of claim's quotation of the Dan Flood / Chief Long text exchange omits the original line "I was told students have access above us," which she says narrows the rooftop reference to the specific walkway above Charlie's head.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed notice of claim text and the underlying original text records to formally document the omission and contextual difference.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges Six Officers Assigned to Outdoor Event
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges UVU assigned only six campus police officers to the outdoor tour event that ultimately attracted approximately 3,000 attendees.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference UVU PD staffing logs from September 10, 2025.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Cites Approximately 3,000 Attendees
claims.claim: The notice of claim states the UVU event attracted approximately 3,000 attendees.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against UVU venue capacity records, ticketing data, and aerial footage crowd estimates.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges Long Requested Additional Officers
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges that UVU Chief Jeff Long requested approval from then-UVU president Astrid Tuminez to allocate more than six officers.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU PD internal communications and presidential approval logs from September 2025.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges Request for Additional Officers Denied
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges that the request for additional officers was denied.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Tuminez's contemporaneous internal communications and PD shift logs.

claims.label: Host Says Bodycam Footage Was Released Seven Days After Suspect Identification
claims.claim: The host says the 2022 bodycam footage of Tyler Robinson was released seven days after the public found out Tyler Robinson was the suspect.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Scripps News publication date and Tyler Robinson's public identification date.

claims.label: Host Says Bodycam Footage Is Dated May 31, 2022
claims.claim: The host says the bodycam footage of Tyler Robinson is dated May 31, 2022, approximately three and a half years before it was released.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the timestamp metadata on the released footage.

claims.label: Bodycam Footage Released by Scripps News
claims.claim: The host says the 2022 bodycam footage was released by Scripps News and shows the headline "Scripps News obtains video of accused Charlie Kirk shooter after 2022 car crash."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Scripps News editorial sourcing notes and FOIAA / records-request logs.

claims.label: Host Says Scripps News Was Founded in 2022 by Jim Spencer
claims.claim: The host says Scripps News, formerly Newsy, became a thing in 2022, the same year as the incident, and that its founder is a man named Jim Spencer.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm corporate registration records for Scripps News and Newsy's corporate history.

claims.label: Host Says Jim Spencer Has Taught Digital Media at UT Austin Since 2018
claims.claim: The host says Jim Spencer teaches digital media and journalism at UT Austin and has done so since 2018, citing his bio on the site.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Spencer's UT Austin faculty page and Nelda Buckman / Buckman Center affiliation.

claims.label: Host Says Bodycam Footage Was Recorded by St. George Police Department
claims.claim: The host says the May 31, 2022 bodycam footage was recorded by an officer in the St. George Police Department.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm agency identification via officer's uniform markings and incident report cross-reference.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler Robinson Was 19 at Time of 2022 Incident
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Robinson was 19 years old at the time of the 2022 traffic incident.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against birth records / official DOB.

claims.label: Host Says UVU Has Approximately 50,000 Students
claims.claim: The host says UVU has a total of 50,000 students.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against UVU's official enrollment figures.

claims.label: Host Says UVU Has 24 Police Officers
claims.claim: The host says UVU has a grand total of 24 police officers available to cover its campus.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against UVU PD staffing rosters and Utah public-safety salary records.

claims.label: Host Says Event Was Scheduled at Amphitheater After Maycee Crofts Demand on August 25, 2025
claims.claim: The host says she is told that on August 25, 2025, TPUSA events committee employee Maycee Crofts insisted during a Microsoft Teams call that the event be held in the amphitheater, and that UVU acquiesced; she says this is not in the filing.
claims.investigative_direction: Recover Microsoft Teams call metadata and any TPUSA event-planning emails.

claims.label: Host Says UVU EMS Was on Scene with First Responders
claims.claim: The host says UVU's state-certified emergency medical services were present beside the vehicle with medical bags in hand.
claims.investigative_direction: Review UVU EMS bodycam footage and any contemporaneous dispatch logs.

claims.label: Host Says UVU Independent Review Findings Were Expected Imminently
claims.claim: The host says she was told the findings of UVU's independent external review of security failures were going to be released on Friday, though she does not know if that will now be bumped.
claims.investigative_direction: Monitor UVU press releases and the Utah Attorney General's office.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie's Security Arrived at 9:00 AM Morning of Event
claims.claim: The host says members of Charlie's security team first arrived on the UVU campus at 9:00 AM on the morning of September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against UVU PD visitor logs and hotel / travel records of the security detail.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges UVU Failed to Maintain Secure Perimeter
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges UVU parties could have created and maintained a secure perimeter with controlled ingress/egress points and security screenings.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare allegation text against UVU's pre-event security plan submission (if any).

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges UVU Could Have Restricted Attendee Numbers
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges UVU parties had the power and authority to impose attendee-number restrictions.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify ticket-sales authority and UVU event-permit conditions.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Concludes with State-Created Danger and Wrongful Death Claims
claims.claim: The notice of claim concludes that "the UVU party's omissions, actions and misconduct led to Mr. Kirk's death" and asserts both a state-created danger claim under the U.S. Constitution's due process clause and a traditional wrongful death claim under Utah law.
claims.investigative_direction: Track subsequent civil complaint filings with the Utah Attorney General's office.

claims.label: Host Says Wall-to-Wall Coverage and Influencers Are Spinning the Notice as a Widow's Fight
claims.claim: The host says there is wall-to-wall coverage of the Kirk family's pending wrongful death suit against the state of Utah and others, and that TPUSA's usual orbit of influencers is spinning it as an aggrieved widow's fight for justice, which she calls another PR game.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the influencer posts and TPUSA statements of September 16, 2026 and compare their framing with the text of the notice.
claims.transcript_snippet: there is basically wall-to-wall coverage regarding a pending wrongful death lawsuit that the Kirk family intends to file against the state of Utah, among others.

claims.label: Host Says the Notice of Claim Is a Mandatory Step Before Suing the Government
claims.claim: The host says a notice of claim is a mandatory prerequisite for this kind of suit, giving the government a chance to concede or settle before litigation.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Utah Governmental Immunity Act notice requirements and the claim deadline.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's it's a mandatory prerequisite for this kind of a lawsuit that you first have to assert your intent to sue the government

claims.label: Host Says Charlie's Parents Urged Erika to Sue Utah Since About December
claims.claim: The host says she has known since approximately last December that it was Charlie Kirk's parents who were encouraging Erika Kirk to file a wrongful death lawsuit against the state of Utah.
claims.investigative_direction: This rests on the host's source; ask the Kirk family or its lawyers when the suit was first discussed.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have known since approximately last December that actually it was Charlie Kirk's parents who were encouraging Erika to file a wrongful death lawsuit against the state of Utah.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Was Not Keen to Sue When She Was Told in December
claims.claim: The host says she was told at that time that suing was not something Erika herself was keen to do.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Erika's public statements on legal action since the shooting.
claims.transcript_snippet: at that time I was told that it was not something that Erika herself was keen to do.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Pulled in a Quarter Billion Last Year
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk was CEO and chairman of an organization that pulled in a quarter billion last year.
claims.investigative_direction: Check TPUSA's latest Form 990 revenue against the quarter-billion figure.
claims.transcript_snippet: CEO and chairman of an organization that pulled in a quarter billion last year

claims.label: Host Says the Independent Review Will Be Devastating to TPUSA's Security Apparatus
claims.claim: The host says she was told the independent review's findings would be devastating to Turning Point USA and its security apparatus because the reviewers would have gathered communications.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the review when released and compare its findings with the host's source.
claims.transcript_snippet: and that the findings were actually going to be devastating to Turning Point USA to their security apparatus because obviously they would have been gathering communications.

claims.label: Host Says the Filing Came Two Days Before the Review and Influencers Are Blaming the Campus
claims.claim: The host says the notice came on Wednesday, two days before the review was due, and that TPUSA is drumming up noise with influencers blaming the campus for the security failures.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the date the review was actually released with the notice date.
claims.transcript_snippet: Two days before the review gets released, suddenly Turning Point USA is drumming up noise and influencers are blaming the campus for the security failures.

claims.label: Host Says She Never Saw 12 Security People Brought to a Campus Event With Charlie
claims.claim: The host says that in all her time doing college campuses with Charlie she never saw 12 security people brought for a campus of this size.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with security staffing at earlier tour stops.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've never seen this in the history of me doing college campuses with Charlie that 12 security people would have been brought with him for a campus of this size.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie's Security Were Not Police but Former SEALs, Marines, Army Snipers and SWAT Commanders
claims.claim: The host says the security team members were not police officers but highly trained military: former Navy SEALs, Marines, Army snipers and SWAT commanders who worked at the highest levels of government.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the team roster and service records against the Harpole interview.
claims.transcript_snippet: highly trained military, former Navy Seals, former Marines, Army snipers, SWAT commanders who worked for the highest levels of government.

claims.label: Host Says She Brought Her Own Security Team to Every Tour Event After Working for TPUSA
claims.claim: The host says she worked for Turning Point USA and, on every tour she went on thereafter, brought her own security team to each event.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for her tour security arrangements; compare with N-10322.
claims.transcript_snippet: I worked for Turning Point USA. On every tour that I went on thereafter, I brought in my own security team to each and every event.

claims.label: Host Says She Requested Bomb Dogs at a Recent Event
claims.claim: The host says that at a recent event she asked the local police to supply bomb dogs, as an example of security liaising with local police.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the event and the police agency to confirm the request.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, you might say, as I did at a recent event, we want bomb dogs.

claims.label: Host Says Local Police Respond With Limits and Security Must Source Its Own Resources or Cancel
claims.claim: The host says that after security asks for items such as drones or a rooftop observer, local police come back with limitations, and the team must then source the items itself or decline to hold the event.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the UVU PD and TPUSA security correspondence about drones and rooftop coverage.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then the local police will then come back at you with potential limitations.

claims.label: Host Says Security Should Be Sent Days Ahead of an Event
claims.claim: The host says a contracted security team would minimally be sent days ahead to make preparations and would not arrive blind to a campus.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the security team's travel and site-visit records for September 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: Minimally, you would send them days ahead to make preparations, right?

claims.label: Notice Says TPUSA Planned Its Largest Ever Campus Tour
claims.claim: The host reads that the eight-page notice, in section B on page three, says Turning Point USA planned its largest ever campus tour in 2025, and she notes it avoids giving a precise date.
claims.investigative_direction: Read page three of the filed notice for the exact wording and any date.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, they tell us that in 2025, Turning Point USA planned its largest ever campus tour.

claims.label: Host Recalls Saying Last Fall the Event Came Together in a Couple of Weeks
claims.claim: The host recalls that she herself, as a former TPUSA speaker who had toured, said last fall that she had never seen an event planned like this, that it came together in a couple of weeks, and that planning normally begins about five months ahead.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the woman and compare UVU approval dates with a normal tour booking lead time.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've never seen an event planned like this. This one came together in a couple of weeks.

claims.label: Host Says UVU Granted This Event Immediately and Nobody Knows Who Filed for It
claims.claim: The host says that despite the usual administrative resistance over insurance and ambulances, this event was granted immediately, and that it is not known who filed for it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the UVU event request, its filer and approval dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: But this one granted immediately. We don't know who filed for it.

claims.label: Notice Says Local Chapter Advocacy Made UVU the First Stop and Cites Known Risks
claims.claim: The host reads that the notice says the local TPUSA chapter's advocacy gave UVU the honor of being the first stop on the fall tour against a well-known backdrop of risk, and paraphrases it as citing the Trump rooftop sniper incident as a risk UVU should have recognized.
claims.investigative_direction: Read the filed notice for the exact risk examples it cites.
claims.transcript_snippet: didn't you know that President Trump uh there was a rooftop sniper?

claims.label: Notice Says UVU Police Did Not Conduct a Risk Assessment or Hold a Security Briefing
claims.claim: The host reads the first negligence point: UVU police did not conduct a meaningful risk assessment and UVU did not hold a security briefing at which rooftop risks, already communicated to Chief Long, could be passed to other officers.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask UVU PD for any written risk assessment or briefing record for September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: UVU police did not conduct a meaningful risk assessment and UVU parties did not have a security briefing

claims.label: Host Says UVU Told Crofts on the Teams Call There Would Be No Traffic Control at the Amphitheater
claims.claim: The host says she is told that on the August 25 Teams call UVU said the event should not be in the amphitheater because there is no traffic control and that the university could not shut the amphitheater down, and that this is not in the filing.
claims.investigative_direction: Recover the Teams call recording or notes and the attendee list.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, you have UVU on the call and they say, "No, you shouldn't do it in the amphitheater because there's no traffic control."

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Loved the Amphitheater at a March 2025 Tennessee Event
claims.claim: The host says the reason for the amphitheater demand was that Charlie had recently done an event in Tennessee in March 2025 where he loved the amphitheater.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the March 2025 Tennessee event and venue.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie had recently done an event in Tennessee and he did, by the way, that's fact. In March of 2025 where he loved the amphitheater

claims.label: Host Says the Notice Does Not Dispute That TPUSA Requested the Amphitheater
claims.claim: The host says the notice does not suggest TPUSA did not request the amphitheater; it argues only that UVU gave TPUSA what it asked for.
claims.investigative_direction: Read the notice's treatment of venue selection for any denial or qualification.
claims.transcript_snippet: They're not like they're not suggesting they didn't request it.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Went In Knowing There Would Be No Traffic Control Yet Sold Tickets
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA went into the event knowing there would be no traffic control, and questions why it would run a ticketed event if anyone could walk up.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the ticketing records and any TPUSA acknowledgement of the no-traffic-control warning.
claims.transcript_snippet: they they went into this knowing that there would be no traffic control.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Told His Security Team the Night Before That He Feared Being Killed
claims.claim: The host says Charlie notified his security team the night before the event that he was worried he was going to be killed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the night-before messages and the recipient list; the host elsewhere names Kolvet and Flood as recipients.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie notified his security team the night before that he was worried that he was going to be killed.

claims.label: Host Says Police Dealt Mostly With the TPUSA Student Club Until 9 a.m. on Event Day
claims.claim: The host says that until security arrived at 9:00 a.m. the police were mostly in contact with the TPUSA campus club, which was managing everything.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU PD correspondence with the campus club and with TPUSA staff before September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: the TPUSA club is managing everything until 9:00 a. m. that morning.

claims.label: Notice Says Six Officers Were Only 25 Percent of the UVU Police Force
claims.claim: The host reads that the notice says Chief Long asked then-president Tuminez to allocate more than six officers, which were only 25 percent of the UVU police force, and the request was denied.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the UVU PD roster and the Long-Tuminez exchange.
claims.transcript_snippet: which represented only 25% of the UVU police force. But this request was denied.

claims.label: Host Argues Six Officers Was an Oversupply Relative to 50,000 Students and 24 Officers
claims.claim: The host says that on 24 officers and 50,000 students, six officers would cover 12,500 students, so the event was oversupplied and denying more protected the other roughly 47,000 students.
